QA-79142 passed 3/3. The report is at `results/2026-10-27/QA-79142-report.md`.

I ran the Tuesday row on UCLA, brand "University of California, Los Angeles", with the Public data set and the Video content type filter. For each channel, the sum of Engagements divided by the sum of Video Views matched the Average row's Video Response Rate once rounded to two decimals:

| Channel | Sum Eng / Sum VV | Ratio | Average row |
|---|---|---|---|
| Facebook | 2,326 / 29,016 | 8.016% | 8.02% |
| Twitter | 463 / 6,068 | 7.630% | 7.63% |
| TikTok | 1,283 / 15,709 | 8.167% | 8.17% |

The case file's Notes line says "Tue UCLA/Sony Pictures", which disagrees with its Description table. I followed the table and ran the first Tuesday entry only, as earlier runs did. Viacom/MTV and Wasserman/Gatorade were not run.

There were no open linked bugs, so nothing was filed. I did no skill or registry updates, as instructed.
